name: Talbutal
aliases: 5-allyl-5-sec-butylbarbituric acid, Lotusate, sec-Butyl allyl barbituric acid, Talbutale, Talbutalum
summary: Talbutal (Lotusate) is a barbiturate with a short to intermediate duration of action. It is a structural isomer of butalbital.S.

pharmacology.text: Talbutal binds at a distinct binding site associated with a Cl− ionophore at the GABAA receptor, increasing the duration of time for which the Cl− ionophore is open. The post-synaptic inhibitory effect of GABA in the thalamus is, therefore, prolonged.

summaryZh: 他布比妥（英語：Talbutal）是一種巴比妥類藥物，作用時間短至中等。它是布他比妥的結構異構體。他布比妥是美國的附表III藥物。
